title: ntn.gps Request Application Programming Interface (API) Schema
description: Determines whether the NTN module should use the location already known to the Notecard. By default it does not. On a Notecard paired with a Starnote, this controls whether the Starnote overrides its own GPS/GNSS module with the location known to the paired Notecard. On Notecard for Skylo, the satellite radio, the cellular modem, and the GPS/GNSS receiver are all the same module, and that module cannot acquire a GPS/GNSS location while it is connecting over NTN. This request controls whether the Notecard supplies a location it already knows to that module as part of connecting, which can significantly reduce the time required to establish a satellite connection.

off.description: When `true`, the Notecard does not supply its location to the NTN module. A paired Starnote uses its own GPS/GNSS module, and Notecard for Skylo connects without a location from the Notecard. This is the default configuration.

on.description: When `true`, the Notecard supplies the location it already knows to the NTN module. That location may be a fixed location set with `card.location.mode`, or one the Notecard acquired during an earlier session. On a Starnote this replaces the location from Starnote's own GPS/GNSS module. If the Notecard does not yet know its location, none is supplied, and this setting has no effect until a location becomes available.

samples.title: Enable Notecard GPS Override
samples.description: Configure the Notecard to supply the location it already knows to the NTN module.

samples.title: Do Not Supply the Notecard's Location
samples.description: Configure the Notecard to not supply its location to the NTN module (default).
